description.text: Late October 7 edition; publication at the actual generation time rather than the scheduled morning slot.

paragraphs.text: Calendar fact: regular US hours are 09:30–16:00 EDT, corresponding to October 7 21:30–October 8 04:00 MYT. At cutoff the session is open, so a completed October 7 close cannot be claimed. Latest completed US session: October 6. Its close, breadth and volume were not independently verified for this report.

paragraphs.text: BEA reported an August goods/services deficit of US$105.6bn against revised July US$92.8bn, released October 6. Interpretation: the wider deficit merits growth/trade monitoring, but does not establish import demand quality, real GDP contribution or a stock-price direction.

sources.label: BEA August international trade release
sources.limitation: Seasonally adjusted nominal trade values; July comparator revised. Not a stock-market or current-day activity measure.

paragraphs.text: Bull scenario: a less restrictive policy read could support risk appetite if verified yields and breadth improve. Bear scenario: persistent inflation concern could pressure duration-sensitive assets. Both are scenarios; no current yield/breadth confirmation is established. A policy read that conflicts with the actual release, or absent close/breadth confirmation, invalidates a directional claim.

paragraphs.text: The US quote-direction labels are derived from last_price versus prev_close_price and match the source timestamps of the included price-only point snapshots.
